real_name_composite: General Syed Asim Munir Ahmed Shah — Chief of Army Staff Pakistan (November 2022–present); former DG ISI (October 2018–June 2019, sacked by Imran Khan); former DG MI

real_life_notes.isi_tenure: Munir served as DG ISI Oct 2018–June 2019. Imran Khan sacked him after 8 months — shortest-ever tenure — reportedly due to a personal dispute over intelligence briefings about Imran's wife. This created a personal vendetta dimension to the 2022-2023 crackdown.
real_life_notes.coas_appointment: Appointed COAS November 29, 2022 by PM Shehbaz Sharif over Imran's opposition. Bajwa hand-picked him. Munir immediately consolidated military authority.
real_life_notes.kashmir_speech: April 16, 2025 — days before Pahalgam — Munir told a gathering: 'Kashmir is our jugular vein. We will not compromise on it.' Indian intelligence flagged the speech as a pre-attack signal.
real_life_notes.pahalgam_authorisation: Indian intelligence assessment: Munir personally authorised the ISI Kashmir Desk operation that culminated in Pahalgam (April 22, 2025), using the domestic distraction hypothesis — Pakistan military legitimacy through Kashmir escalation.

objective: Consolidate Pakistani military authority over all civilian and security functions; neutralise PTI/Imran political threat; use Kashmir escalation to restore military legitimacy domestically; maintain nuclear deterrence credibility vs India; manage IMF/China/Gulf economic stabilisation simultaneously
oracle_threat_note: Film 4's primary strategic adversary — the architect behind both the post-Imran Pakistan consolidation and the Pahalgam→Sindoor escalation. Personal history with Imran creates a paranoid, consolidation-driven decision style. Higher loss aversion than Bajwa — more willing to escalate under domestic pressure.
